meta.title: origem.dev — Unlimited Design for Churches + a Free Church Website
meta.description: Subscription graphic design for American churches and ministries. Unlimited requests, fast turnaround, and a free custom church website with every plan.
hero.h1: Every graphic your church needs. Plus a website, on us.
hero.lead: Sermon series, Sunday slides, events and social posts — designed by a dedicated team for one flat monthly fee. On Unlimited Graphics or Pro, we also build your church a custom website for free.
svc.h2: One team for everything your ministry shares
svc.p1: Title graphics, slides, lower thirds and social cut-downs that carry one look across the whole series.
svc.p2: Lyric backgrounds, announcement loops and welcome screens ready for ProPresenter or any presentation software.
svc.p3: Holiday services, VBS, conferences, retreats and baptisms — flyers, banners and invites.
svc.p4: Weekly posts, stories and verse graphics sized for Instagram, Facebook and YouTube.
svc.p5: Bold, age-appropriate designs for student and children's ministries.
svc.p6: Bulletins, connection cards, signage, merch and refreshed church logos.
web.h2: A free custom website with Unlimited Graphics & Pro
web.p1: Your website is the first door most visitors walk through. Subscribe to Unlimited Graphics ($490/mo) or Pro ($590/mo) and we design and build a modern, mobile-friendly site for your church at no extra cost.
web.p2: Already have a site? We'll update it, fix what's broken and keep it current — also free.
web.note: The Social Media plan does not include a website.
web.f3: Service times, location, ministries and giving links
price.sub: Unlimited Graphics and Pro include a free church website (or free updates and fixes to your current one). Social Media does not.
plan.s.desc: Consistent weekly content for your channels.
plan.u.desc: Everything your Sundays and events need.
price.secure: 🔒 Secure checkout powered by Stripe · Billed monthly in USD · Cancel anytime · 14-day risk-free guarantee
proc.h2: From request to ready in four steps
proc.p1: Send your idea through a simple request form — text, references, deadlines.
proc.p2: Your designer gets to work. Most requests are back within 1–2 business days.
proc.p3: Ask for changes as many times as you need until it's right.
proc.p4: Download final files sized for screens, print and social. On Unlimited or Pro, we build your website alongside.
cmp.caption: Comparison of origem.dev with other options
tst.p: Testimonials coming soon — be one of our first partner churches.
g.p: If the work isn't what your church needs in the first 14 days, tell us and we'll refund you. No hard feelings.
faq.a1: Submit as many requests as you like. We work through them in order, one (or more, depending on your plan) at a time.
faq.a2: Yes, on the Unlimited Graphics ($490/mo) and Pro ($590/mo) plans. Those churches get a custom website designed and built at no extra charge. If you already have one, we update and fix it instead.
faq.a3: You do. All final files are yours to use however your ministry needs.
faq.q4: What happens to my website if I cancel?
faq.a4: We'll talk through options with you — including handing the site over so you keep it.
faq.q5: Does the Social Media plan include a website?
faq.a5: No. The free website (or free updates to your existing site) comes with Unlimited Graphics and Pro. You can upgrade anytime.
faq.a6: Yes. There are no long-term contracts.
faq.q7: What file formats do I get?
faq.a7: PNG, JPG, PDF and source files on request, sized for screens, print and social.
ct.p: Book a free 20-minute consultation. We'll learn about your ministry and show you what we can design — and build.
